title: Composite Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm (ML-DSA) for Use in the Cryptographic Message Syntax (CMS)
source: Limited Additional Mechanisms for PKIX and SMIME
abstract: The Composite Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm (ML-DSA) defines combinations of ML-DSA with RSA, ECDSA, and EdDSA. This document specifies the conventions for using Composite ML-DSA algorithms within the Cryptographic Message Syntax (CMS).
